highlight.title: New GCSE 2026 changes boost problem-solving focus
highlight.summary: GCSE 2026 exams feature significant shifts toward application-based questions in Maths and Science, with digital exam options launching for some subjects. Students will continue receiving formula sheets for Maths, Physics, and Combined Science through 2027 to focus on understanding rather than memorisation.

resources.title: Year 6 SATs 2026: Complete dates and revision guide
resources.why_now: Parents and Year 6 students - SATs week runs 11-14 May 2026, just days away, with detailed timetable and last-minute revision strategies available.

resources.title: GCSE formula sheets confirmed until 2027
resources.why_now: Students in Years 10-11 - formula sheets for GCSE Maths, Physics and Combined Science exams continue through 2027, allowing focus on problem-solving over memorisation.

resources.title: Oak National Academy RSHE curriculum updates
resources.why_now: Parents and teachers - new RSHE resources launched 13 May covering sensitive topics like bereavement, vaping, AI chatbots and online safety for updated curriculum requirements.

resources.title: New Year 8 diagnostic tests in development
resources.why_now: Parents of Year 7-8 students - government announces new statutory Year 8 diagnostic tests in Maths and English from 2026/27 to identify learning gaps earlier in secondary school.

claude_take: This week marks a pivotal moment with GCSE changes emphasising real-world problem-solving over rote memorisation, while Year 6 SATs imminent arrival reminds us that assessment should support, not define, a child's educational journey. The extension of formula sheets and focus on application skills suggests a welcome shift toward deeper understanding in UK education.
